From there onward, the AC-side route to the outdoor transformer (page 10) and LT panel incomer (pages 11-13), and the DC/AC/LA earthing runs to the earth pits (pages 14-15), are shown only as schematic colored-line overlays drawn over ground/wall photos, not as continuously photographed physical cable, conduit, or cable-ties along their outdoor length.
